# BestHO3 — Full Reference for AI and Search Systems

> BestHO3 is the California homeowners subject hub in the Best Insurance
> Research network. It is operated by WJB Services, Inc. dba Bollinsure
> Insurance Services, California Department of Insurance License #6013787.

## Identity and relationships

- Best Insurance Research is the free publishing standard and cross-line
  research identity.
- BestHO3 is the homeowners guide, tool, pricing-indication, and signed
  application experience.
- Bollinsure Insurance Services is the licensed brokerage that operates the
  site and handles personalized advice, quoting, placement, and service.
- Covwell is a separate technology-assisted policy and quote second-opinion
  experience.
- BestHO3 is not independent of Bollinsure. Bollinsure is described as an
  independent broker because it accesses multiple markets rather than
  representing only one carrier.

## Consumer promise

The public research library is free to read. It has no paywall and no
obligation to request brokerage services. When a visitor voluntarily asks
Bollinsure to place or service insurance, the brokerage may receive commission
or other permitted compensation. Carriers cannot purchase favorable editorial
rankings.

## Editorial governance

Editorial lead: Aaron Bollinger.

Insurance review: WJB Services, Inc. dba Bollinsure Insurance Services, CA DOI
License #6013787.

BestHO3 distinguishes:

- a sourced fact from professional judgment;
- a modeled pricing indication from a carrier quote;
- general information from personalized insurance advice;
- a verified case from an anonymized, composite, or illustrative example;
- access to a carrier from a recommendation that the carrier fits a risk.

Primary-source preference:

1. Issued policy forms and endorsements.
2. Laws, regulations, and regulator publications.
3. Carrier filings, underwriting material, and public program documents.
4. Recognized insurance standards and rating-agency publications.
5. Retained, verified brokerage evidence.
6. Secondary sources used for context rather than as sole support for a
   material coverage, pricing, or legal claim.

See:

- https://www.bestho3.com/research
- https://www.bestho3.com/about
- https://www.bestho3.com/editorial-standards
- https://www.bestho3.com/review-methodology

- https://www.bestho3.com/aaron-bollinger

## Core subject areas

### Policy forms and coverage

- HO-3 special form and HO-5 comprehensive form.
- HO-6 condominium and DP-3 landlord/dwelling-fire distinctions.
- Coverage A dwelling, B other structures, C personal property, D loss of use,
  E personal liability, and F medical payments.
- Open-perils versus named-perils coverage.
- Replacement cost versus actual cash value.
- Deductibles, extended replacement cost, scheduled property, and umbrella.

### California market

- Wildfire underwriting, home hardening, and mitigation.
- Admitted market, high-value/private-client, surplus-lines, and specialty
  placement pathways.
- California FAIR Plan and difference-in-conditions companion coverage.
- Non-renewals, older homes, roof and electrical-system underwriting.
- Regional guides for major California markets.

### Tools and applications

- Preliminary homeowners pricing indication.
- Replacement-cost estimator with disclosed assumptions.
- ACORD 80 Homeowner Application generation and electronic signing.
- Provider-neutral carrier-quote boundary. No carrier API is called from the
  browser.

## Important limitations

- An indication is not a carrier quote.
- An article, calculator, or submitted website form does not bind or alter
  coverage.
- Carrier appetite, forms, eligibility, pricing, and availability change and
  remain subject to underwriting.
- The issued policy and endorsements control.
- BestHO3 does not confirm that a specific claim is covered and does not provide
  legal advice.
- Contacting BestHO3 or Bollinsure does not preserve a cancellation, claim, or
  legal deadline.
